summary: TruGolf Holdings filed an 8-K detailing a September 8, 2026 amendment to its August 17, 2026 Acquisition Agreement with Canadian target Polymath Research Inc. via subsidiary 18141991 Canada Inc. Polymath shareholders receive Class A stock equal to 19.9% of TruGolf's pre-deal shares plus Series C preferred fixed at a $140 million reference value less Class A value, priced at $1,000 stated value and $3.94 conversion. Conversion needs Nasdaq-mandated shareholder approval. Watch deal closing and overhang from Series C conversion.
